repair_reason.old_rule: All 93 transformer layers were required to use physically admitted degree-8 sub-layer execution.
repair_reason.finding: The rule was over-constrained: Kimi K3 layer 0 is structurally different and its admitted whole-layer candidate fits the frozen commodity worker class.
repair_reason.corrected_rule: Layer 0 uses layer-00:WHOLE_LAYER:p1 on one ordinary commodity worker; layers 1 through 92 remain physically admitted production-native degree-8 sub-layer only, with WHOLE_LAYER forbidden.

scientific_question: Can ordinary fragmented commodity workers sustain correct Kimi K3 output tokens below the frozen $15/M API benchmark when the naturally small dense layer 0 executes whole and the 92 whole-layer-infeasible transformer layers execute only through admitted degree-8 sub-layer candidates?
falsifiable_hypothesis: At least two of the three frozen network scenarios will contain an SLO-feasible, exact, fully costed commodity point below $15/M under the repaired one-whole-plus-92-P8 architecture.
mandatory_validity_boundary: Any mandatory candidate, memory, calibration, correctness, architecture, reconciliation, reproducibility, or immutable-input failure yields MODEL_INVALID before scientific interpretation.
design_provenance: No Stage A, Stage B, token-throughput, or economic performance result was used to design this repair.
